metaTitle: Network Controls That Support Your Compliance | SecuEdge
metaDescription: SecuEdge Frontier gives you network segmentation, strict access rules, threat blocking and exportable logs — controls that support DPDP, RBI, SEBI and CERT-In obligations.

hero.headline: Network controls that support your compliance.
hero.sub: Regulators and auditors want to see who accessed what, that sensitive systems are separated, and that threats are blocked. SecuEdge Frontier gives you those controls and the logs to prove them. Compliance remains your responsibility; we make the network part easier.

challenges.headline: What auditors ask to see.
challenges.sub: Whatever the framework, the network questions are the same: who accessed what, are sensitive systems separated, and are threats blocked?

items.title: Who accessed what

items.title: Separated sensitive systems

items.title: Blocked threats
items.desc: Evidence that attacks, malware and malicious sites are stopped at the edge.

items.title: Controlled remote access
items.desc: VPN connections limited to the people and systems that need them.

items.title: Data kept in India
items.desc: Traffic, logs and policy data on Indian soil by default, with no overseas routing.

items.title: Continuity
items.desc: Backup internet paths and failover so critical systems stay online.

faqsIntro.headline: Frequently asked questions
faqsIntro.sub: Honest answers about what a firewall can and cannot do for compliance.

faqs.q: Does SecuEdge Frontier make us compliant?
faqs.a: No product alone does. SecuEdge Frontier provides network controls and logs that support your compliance programme. Compliance remains your responsibility.
In India, by default. Traffic, logs and policy data stay on Indian soil, with no overseas routing.

faqs.q: Can we export logs for our auditor?
faqs.a: Yes. Per-device logs and reports are exportable as audit evidence.

faqs.q: Our India-based team understands Indian regulation. Can you help map controls to our audit checklist?
faqs.a: Talk to us about your audit requirements. Our India-based team understands Indian regulation and will walk through how SecuEdge Frontier controls map to your checklist.

faqs.q: We also work with overseas clients. Does that change anything?
faqs.a: No. The same controls — segmentation, strict rules, threat blocking and logs — help with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA requirements.
